独立表格、Oakland 领取地点及避免重复报失。: Separate claim form, Oakland collection location and avoiding duplicate claims.

先画出今天的三个固定点：退房地点、行李领取地点、最终出发地点。编辑建议最后一天只: Mark three fixed points: checkout, baggage collection and final departure. Keep the last day’s outing near that chain rather than combining storage, a cross-city trip and a flight. Recalculate collection and transport whenever one part changes.
先问住宿处是否接受退房后寄存、最晚取件、按件还是按时收费、贵重品限制，以及取件是: Ask the accommodation whether it accepts post-checkout bags, the last collection time, per-item or hourly fees, valuables restrictions and required room number or claim ticket. Each property sets its policy.
拍下行李外观和寄存凭条，保留柜台位置；把当天用的证件、药品、充电宝和交通支付工具: Photograph the bags and claim ticket, save the desk location, and keep needed ID, medicines, a power bank and travel payment method in a day bag.
若酒店不收，先比较经其确认的寄存服务与提前去机场；核对真实营业地址、营业时间、超: If the hotel declines, compare a storage provider you can verify with heading to the airport earlier. Check the operating address, hours, overtime and collection rules before paying.
SFO 官方 FAQ 确认机场行李寄存由 Airport Travel Agen: SFO’s FAQ identifies Airport Travel Agency baggage storage on the International Terminal’s departures/ticketing level near G1–G14, daily 6am–11pm. Reservations are not required and bags are X-rayed. This is at the airport, not a downtown storage branch.
机场寄存按每件物品每 24 小时计费，不足 24 小时也按该档计，价格随尺寸而变: Airport storage is charged per item per 24-hour period, including stays shorter than 24 hours; size affects the price and the FAQ gives no flat amount. Ask for a size-based quote and collection requirements. Include the airport detour if you only want a short downtown outing.
查看 SFO 当前寄存与航站楼服务: Check current SFO storage and terminal services
从官方 FAQ 进入 Airport Travel Agency 的联系页，核对: Follow the FAQ to Airport Travel Agency’s contact page for hours, size-based prices and special-item rules. No reservation requirement does not imply unlimited capacity.
寄存没有落实时，缩小当天路线: If storage is unresolved, simplify the day
编辑建议改为先办理可用寄存、在附近用餐或直接去机场。不要默认每个景点、码头或餐厅: Arrange confirmed storage first, eat nearby or head to the airport. Do not assume attractions, piers or restaurants accept suitcases, or use a car boot as a substitute for a considered storage plan.
找卫生间：保存两个点和各自时段: Restrooms: save two locations and their hours
SF Public Works 的 Pit Stop 页面列有人值守的公共厕所与: The SF Public Works Pit Stop page lists staffed public toilets with individual hours: Embarcadero Plaza 9am–5pm, Grove/Larkin 7am–7pm and Market/Castro 8am–8pm daily. These are location-specific schedules, not a citywide 24-hour service.
出门前在官方地点表找沿线的主选和备选，记录交叉路口而非只记街区；带孩子的人可在开: Choose a primary and backup location on the official list, saving the intersection rather than just the neighborhood. Families can use a restroom before a longer walk.
到场关闭、排队太久或设施不适用时，去备选点，或询问当前参观场馆的服务台；不要假设: If closed, too busy or unsuitable, use the backup or ask the facility you are visiting. Do not assume a business must provide a free restroom.
需要轮椅转身空间、陪护者同行或婴儿换尿布台时，提前问具体设施；“有厕所”不能替代: Ask specifically about wheelchair turning space, a companion or baby-changing facilities. The presence of a restroom alone does not confirm these features.
保存 Pit Stop 地点与营业时间: Save Pit Stop locations and hours
查看你实际路线上的路口和日期时段；设施临时停用时可向 311 查询，不靠旧地图截: Check intersections and hours along your route. Ask 311 about temporary issues instead of treating an old map screenshot as a guarantee.
无障碍：逐段确认从街面到目的地: Accessibility: check every segment from the street
SFMTA 说明 Muni Metro 地下站通过电梯提供无障碍通道，但“该站有: SFMTA describes elevator access at Muni Metro subway stations, but an accessible station may still have an elevator outage. Check the origin, transfers and destination before leaving; ask station staff or 311 about a surface alternative when needed.
地面轻轨要看具体无障碍上车站点；历史缆车则没有无障碍上车设施。要坐轮椅或无法踏上: Surface light rail requires checking the specific accessible boarding stop; historic cable cars do not provide accessible boarding. Choose usable transport before attractions for wheelchair users or anyone unable to climb high steps. Muni services do not all have the same boarding conditions.
告诉运营方轮椅或辅助器具的类型、是否能离开座椅、同行人数；按其要求补充尺寸与重量: Describe the mobility device, whether the rider can transfer and party size; provide dimensions or weight if requested rather than only asking whether access is easy.
向目的地确认无台阶入口、服务台、可用厕所和休息点；从车站到门口的坡度与路面也要算: Confirm the step-free entrance, service desk, suitable restroom and rest points, including gradients and surfaces from the stop to the door.
关键电梯停用时，取消该段或改地面路线；由本人判断舒适度，不临时要求同行者搬抬轮椅: If a crucial elevator is out, change or cancel that segment. Let the traveler assess comfort; do not improvise carrying a wheelchair on stairs.
按站点查 Muni Metro 上下车条件: Check Muni Metro boarding conditions by stop
从 SFMTA 无障碍指南确认地下和地面上车方式，再检查实时设施；这是路线核对入: Use SFMTA’s access guide for subway and surface boarding, then check live facilities. The guide is a planning reference, not a guarantee that elevators work today.
东西不见了：先按最后出现地点分流: Missing belongings: start with where they were last seen
先回想最后一次确定看到物品的时间、地点、车厢或座位，记录物品品牌、颜色、独特特征: Record the last certain time and place, vehicle or seat, item make, color, distinctive details and a reachable email address. One person can contact the organization while another collects trip evidence. Do not post phone passcodes or full ID numbers publicly.
Muni 官方要求：若钱包、手机、证件、药品等重要物品可能在最近四小时内遗留车上: Muni asks riders to contact 311 immediately for important items such as a wallet, phone, documents or medicine left within the past four hours; outside SF use 415-701-2311. Otherwise use its online claim route. Wait for collection instructions instead of making a walk-up inquiry.
BART 有独立的失物表格，不能用 Muni 登记代替。官网提醒同一物品不要重复: BART has its own form, separate from Muni, and asks you not to submit duplicate claims. Its office is at 12th St/Oakland City Center; staffing can change opening hours, so call 510-464-7090 before visiting. A pending claim is not a promise of recovery before you leave.
SFO 飞机内遗失：联系航空公司；不要先填机场公共区域的表格。: Lost onboard an aircraft at SFO: contact the airline, rather than starting with the airport public-area department.
SFO 航站楼、停车库或 AirTrain：官方列机场警察失物部门，电话 650: SFO terminals, garages or AirTrain: the airport lists its police lost-property department, 650-821-7014, sfolostandfound@flysfo.com.
SFO 安检处：按机场页面转 Covenant Aviation Securit: SFO security checkpoints: follow the airport page to Covenant Aviation Security, 650-457-2670. This is separate from an airline delayed-baggage claim.
我在［当地日期／时间］乘坐［机构／线路／方向］，从［上车点］到［下车点］，可能把: On [local date/time] I traveled on [operator/route/direction] from [origin] to [destination] and may have left [make, color, model, distinctive marks] at [seat/car/area]. I last definitely had it at [location]. Existing claim reference: [number]. Contact: [email/phone]. I leave the Bay Area on [date]. Please advise on verification and collection.
失窃或证件丢失：不要把报失当报案: Theft or missing documents: distinguish claims from police reports
有人身危险、武器或犯罪正在发生时拨 911；已结束的 SF 非紧急案件可拨 SF: Call 911 for immediate danger, weapons or a crime in progress. For a non-emergency incident in SF, call SFPD at 415-553-0123. Its online-report rules exclude lost or stolen foreign passports, which require a police-station report; then contact the issuing country’s official consular service.
记录发生地、当地时间、物品清单、可证明的价值及已有照片；把“亲眼看到”与“推测”: Record location, local time, items, supportable value and existing photos; distinguish what you witnessed from what you infer.
向租车公司、住宿处或保险方询问所需报案编号和材料；保留原始收据，不自行保证一定理: Ask the rental company, accommodation or insurer what report reference and evidence they require. Keep original receipts; do not assume reimbursement or immediate replacement documents.
警方案件按事发辖区处理；在 Oakland、San José 或其他城市发生的事: Police jurisdiction follows the incident location. Do not report an Oakland, San José or other city incident as occurring in SF simply because your hotel is there.
核对 SFPD 线上、电话与现场报案入口: Check SFPD online, phone and in-person reporting
先阅读适用范围；网页提供中文入口及语言协助说明。提交前确认事发地点和事件类型，保: Read eligibility first. The page offers Chinese reporting and language-assistance information. Confirm the location and incident type, then save submission details and later reference numbers.
返程受影响时，先处理必须的证件与联系: If departure is affected, prioritize documents and contacts
编辑建议暂停加景点：先联系航空公司和相应证件机构，确认能否按原计划出行，再改住宿: Pause sightseeing. Contact the airline and relevant document authority to confirm whether travel remains possible before changing accommodation or transport. Lost-property claims, police reports, replacement documents and insurance are separate processes; one receipt does not replace another.
